name: Lutian Machinery Co., Ltd.
summary: Lutian Machinery Co., Ltd. engages in the research, design, development, production, and sale of general power machinery and high-pressure washers in China. It offers high pressure washers, such as commercial and consumer washers; power equipment, including engines, inverter generators, LT and LS generators, and water pumps; and pressure washer and power equipment accessories. It also exports its products to Europe, South America, North America, Africa, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, and internationally. Lutian Machinery Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Taizhou, China.
